sections.title: React
paragraphs: This page is built entirely with React, using Vite as a bundler to provide a fast development environment and optimized builds.
I have applied a modular structure with several reusable components to facilitate code scalability and maintainability.

The design is responsive: in addition to using dynamic variables and applying adaptive CSS styles, some navigation menu logic adjusts depending on the device (desktop or mobile) to optimize the user experience.

I have implemented controlled components using useState and developed custom hooks to encapsulate repetitive logic, such as managing dropdown menus, automatically closing them when clicking outside the component, or synchronizing active sections with scrolling.
The interface incorporates smooth animations with Framer Motion and conditional styles in several components to enhance user interaction and visual feedback.
I have integrated multilingual support with react-i18next, organizing content into separate namespaces to keep the code clear and maintainable.

For infrastructure, I rely on Netlify for hosting and automatic deployment of the page from the repository, ensuring a structured workflow. As part of this workflow, I use GitHub as a version control system, maintaining an organized and well-segmented commit history.

sections.title: WordPress
paragraphs: This travel blog is built with WordPress and its design focuses on visual content, highlighting a wide image gallery.
I have implemented an email subscription system using the MailPoet plugin, which allows users to receive news and blog updates.
I have set up custom pop-ups related to the Newsletter subscription using Popup Maker.

I have incorporated code snippets with Code Snippets plugin to customize the site’s functionality. Specifically, I added links to the YouTube channel featured on the site, so that each post connects to related videos, thereby maximizing visits.
I have optimized search engine ranking with Yoast SEO, improving both metadata and content structure.
I have configured the multilanguage option with TranslatePress to expand the blog’s international reach.
For infrastructure management, I have registered and managed the domain on Namecheap and configured the hosting with EasyWP.
I carry out continuous maintenance of the site, including reviewing updates for the site and plugins, as well as performing regular backups.
